plugins.name: trader-skill-india
plugins.description: Twelve skills for Indian stocks (NSE/BSE): copy a mutual fund's monthly portfolio or an investor's disclosed stakes, watch exchange filings, insider trades, pledges and bulk deals, read quarterly results, screen, size in whole shares with STT and charges, check SEBI and exchange rules, capital gains tax (FIFO, 112A, grandfathering), price alerts on the NSE clock, rebalancing, and order tickets that need your yes.
